'''John Charles Butcher''' {{post-nominals|country=NZL|ONZM}} (born 31 March 1933) is a New Zealand [[mathematician]] who specialises in [[numerical methods]] for the solution of [[ordinary differential equations]].<ref name=rsnz>{{Citation | author1=The Royal Society of New Zealand | author1-link=Royal Society of New Zealand | title=2010 Jones Medal Winner Professor Emeritus John Butcher | type=media release | date=10 Nov 2010 | url=http://www.royalsociety.org.nz/2010/11/10/jones-medal-winner-professor-emeritus-john-butcher/ | access-date=22 Mar 2012 | archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20130212043904/http://www.royalsociety.org.nz/2010/11/10/jones-medal-winner-professor-emeritus-john-butcher/ | archive-date=12 February 2013 | url-status=dead | df=dmy-all }}.</ref>

Butcher works on multistage methods for [[initial value problem]]s, such as [[Runge-Kutta]] and [[Linear multistep method|general linear methods]]. The [[Butcher group]] and the [[Butcher tableau]] are named after him.
More recently, he is investigating a new type of method with stability identical to that of a [[Runge-Kutta method]].

==Biography==
{| class="wikitable floatright" | width="250"
|- style="text-align:center;"
| Positions held by John C. Butcher
|-
|
* Lecturer, [[University of Sydney]], 1959–1961.
* Senior Lecturer, [[University of Canterbury]], 1961–1964.
* Computer Scientist, [[Stanford Linear Accelerator Center]], 1965–1966.<ref>{{cite web|url=http://www.jucs.org/jucs_articles_by_author/Butcher_John_C_/BusinessCard |title=Butcher John C |access-date=2011-12-30 |url-status=dead |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20120415035918/http://www.jucs.org/jucs_articles_by_author/Butcher_John_C_/BusinessCard |archive-date=15 April 2012 }}</ref>
* Professor of Mathematics, [[University of Auckland]], 1966–1979.
* Head of Mathematics Department, University of Auckland, 1967–1973.
* Founded Department of Computer Science, University of Auckland, 1980.
* Professor of Computer Science, University of Auckland, 1980–1988.
* Head of Applied and Computational Mathematics Unit, University of Auckland, 1989–1994, 1997–1998.
* Professor of Mathematics, University of Auckland, 1989–1999.
* Emeritus Professor, University of Auckland, 1999–present.
|}
Butcher studied mathematics at [[Auckland University College]] - BSc and MSc  - and the [[University of Sydney]] - PhD (1961) and DSc. 
Positions held are as aside.

He was awarded the Jones Medal from the [[Royal Society of New Zealand]] in 2010, for his "exceptional lifetime work on numerical methods for the solution of differential equations and leadership in the development of New Zealand mathematical sciences."<ref name=rsnz />  In 2011, he received the [[Van Wijngaarden Award]].<ref>{{cite press release |title=Van Wijngaarden Award 2011 for Éva Tardos and John Butcher |url=http://www.cwi.nl/news/2011/van-wijngaarden-award-2011-%C3%A9va-tardos-and-john-butcher |publisher=Centrum Wiskunde & Informatica |date=10 February 2011 |access-date=12 February 2011 |url-status=dead |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20110221230825/http://www.cwi.nl/news/2011/van-wijngaarden-award-2011-%C3%A9va-tardos-and-john-butcher |archive-date=21 February 2011 |df=dmy-all }}</ref>

In the [[2013 Birthday Honours (New Zealand)|2013 Queen's Birthday Honours]], Butcher was appointed an [[Officer of the New Zealand Order of Merit]], for services to mathematics.<ref>{{cite web |url=https://www.dpmc.govt.nz/publications/queens-birthday-honours-list-2013 |title=Queen's Birthday honours list 2013 |date=3 June 2013 |publisher=Department of the Prime Minister and Cabinet |access-date=18 June 2018}}</ref>
